description: Add a rigid block thermal history.

keywords.name: id
keywords.description: Take the history of the thermal rigid block with this ID.

keywords.name: position
keywords.description: Take the history of the thermal rigid block closest to this position.

examples.description: Track the temperature of thermal rigid block 1
Track the out-of-balance power of the object closest to a position

notes: The rblock manual keeps the 'id <i>' history selector in all versions; live, 7.00 and 9.8 also accept 'name <s>'.
The 9.0 manual also lists an 'extra' quantity for rblock thermal history; it is rejected live on 7.00 and 9.8 ('Bad conversion of parameter number 4 (extra)').
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): temperature and power-unbalanced histories created with both the id and position selectors on all six consoles; the name selector also accepted on 7.00 and 9.8.
